# Under --output-datastar the reserved signals argument is shorthand for
# unmarshalJSON(body): Datastar sends the page's signal state as the JSON
# request body, so both spellings bind identically.

muxt generate --output-datastar --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET / Index(ctx)" -}}{{- .Result.Query -}}{{- end -}}
{{- define "POST /search sse(Search(ctx, signals, sseResults))" -}}{{- end -}}
{{- define "sseResults" -}}<output id="q">{{ .Result.Query }}</output>{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Signals struct {
	Query string `json:"query"`
}

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Index(_ context.Context) (Signals, error) { return Signals{}, nil }

func (Server) Search(_ context.Context, signals Signals, sseResults func(Signals) error) {
	_ = sseResults(signals)
}
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestSignals(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/search", strings.NewReader(`{"query":"mutex"}`))
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusOK)
	}
	body := rec.Body.String()
	for _, want := range []string{
		"event: datastar-patch-elements\n",
		`data: elements <output id="q">mutex</output>` + "\n",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(body, want) {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want the wire line %q", body, want)
		}
	}

	malformed := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/search", strings.NewReader("not-json"))
	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, malformed)
	if rec.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
		t.Errorf("malformed signals status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusBadRequest)
	}
}
